paper_title: The topological susceptibility in finite temperature QCD and axion cosmology
coupling_convention: T_osc (axion oscillation temperature) in MeV, lower edge of the 'this work' band; NOT m_a
notes: Lattice QCD calculation of the topological susceptibility chi_t(T) used to derive a cosmological bound on the QCD axion decay constant assuming post-inflation PQ breaking and axion = 100% DM. The single quantitative result is f_a <= 1.2e12 GeV (~10-20% uncertainty from K-factor). The main figure (Fig. 6) is the f_a vs T_osc plane, NOT an f_a-m_a exclusion curve, and no coupling-vs-mass data table exists. There is no extractable (mass, coupling) exclusion curve; only a single upper bound on f_a. Not a haloscope/DM-density experiment, so no local DM density.
